english.title: Use adult firework during night hours - Firework Reg's 2004

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: prohibition on the use of fireworks

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used an adult firework during night hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TIME OR TIMES..), that being a time and date not exempt from a prohibition on such use as provided by regulation 7(2) of the Fireworks Regulations 2004
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(1) of the Fireworks Regulations 2004 and section 11(1) and (4) of the Fireworks Act 2003.

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA13

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £80 to £90 on 01/07/13
(ii) See regulation 7(2) for the exemptions to this prohibition
(iii) See regulation 7(3) for the meaning of "night hours".

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Penalty Notice for Disorder - Ninety Pounds.

Note:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months (see regulation 13 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004)

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
